description: Neither indexes.md nor index-service.md mentions index state at all - no created/building/online lifecycle, and no statement that an index must be built before it serves queries. The registry already holds an index-state scheme promoted from the reference tree (system:indexes monitoring, round 8), so the ontology knows about a lifecycle the conceptual documentation never introduces. A reader coming to indexes.md first learns that indexes exist and are maintained, but not that creating one is asynchronous or that querying too early behaves differently.
